trait.name: Misha, Focus!
trait.description:
Passive: Misha gains 15% move speed. 

Command Misha to attack a specific enemy or move to a point and wait.

Targeting Rexxar commands Misha to retreat to his position, gaining 30% move speed until she reaches Rexxar.

Targeting Misha commands her to hold her current position.

activable.name: Flare
activable.description: Fire a flare at an area, revealing it for 20 seconds.

activable.name: Feign Death
activable.description: Rexxar fakes his death, becoming Invulnerable and untargetable for 5 seconds. During this time you control Misha.

activable.name: Primal Intimidation
activable.description:
Activate to Slow the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of Heroes and Summons near Rexxar and Misha for 2.5 seconds.

Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack Rexxar or Misha have their Attack Speed slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

activable.name: Hardened Skin
activable.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Armor for 4 seconds, reducing damage taken by 75%.

level1.name: Easy Prey

level4.name: Hungry Bear
level4.description: Misha's Basic Attacks heal her for 4.5% of her maximum Health.

level4.name: Hunter-Gatherer
level4.description:
Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Rexxar and Misha's Health Regeneration by 1 per second, up to 25 per second. 

Reward: After gathering 25 Globes, Rexxar and Misha gain 15 Armor.

level4.name: Grizzled Fortitude
level4.description:
Every 6 seconds, Rexxar and Misha gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%.

Stores up to 2 charges. Both Rexxar and Misha have their own charges.

level4.name: Animal Husbandry
level4.description: Rexxar and Misha gain 2 Maximum Health every second Rexxar remains alive. These bonuses are lost on Rexxar's death.

level7.name: Taking Flight
level7.description: Increases Spirit Swoop's range by 20%. If Spirit Swoop hits an enemy Hero, the Mana cost is refunded and its cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.

level7.name: Aspect of the Beast
